name: Game Show
summary: A flat-vector quiz show: candy-coloured sets with stripes, dots and sunbursts, bean contestants with thick ink outlines, white and yellow telops with ink strokes and hard shadows, everything popping on a 150 BPM beat, and a judgement word when a round is won.

palette.use: navy: the ending set and the last fade; the engine's ground colour
cream: round cards, scoreboards, banners, telop plates
telop fill on a set, catch-lights, mitten hands
every outline, every hard shadow, text on cream, name-tag pills
grey props, the empty part of a bar
deep purple: the purple set's floor
yellow: emphasised telop words, the judgement word, burst stars, the sun
pink: blush, a judgement word on a non-pink set
candy red: the RED contestant, red light, open mouths
candy sky: the AIR MOLECULE contestant
candy blue: the BLUE contestant, blue light, emphasis on cream

type.case: sentence; tags and round names in capitals
type.emphasis: yellow fill on a set; the set's own hue on cream

banned: gradients, blur, texture, glow or soft shadows: flat fills and hard ink shadows only
slow fade-ins, dissolves or crossfades (hard cuts with a 0.08 s white flash; one fade to navy at the very end)
anything off the beat grid: every pop, drop and stamp lands on a beat or a subdivision
the same hue for neighbouring sets, or for a character and its set
thin generic captions: words are outlined telops or sit on cream cards
real game shows' names, characters, logos, stages or music; real logos or product UI
invented scores or numbers: a counter only races to a true number
realistic characters or faces: contestants are beans
